newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin moves to sanatorium from Moscow hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin moves to sanatorium from Moscow hospital.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin moved to the official Barvikha sanatorium near Moscow and he will be working there and taking walks, the presidential press office said on Monday.

Yeltsin, who is getting ready for a heart bypass operation, had spent almost a month in the Central Clinical Hospital. Doctors said on Monday Yeltsin's condition was "quite satisfactory", the press office said.
A Kremlin spokesman said Yeltsin's workload and the volume of his physical activity would be increased at the sanatorium. A number of meetings were planned this week.

He said the president arrived at Barvikha over the weekend and had met Igor Stroyev, chairman of the Federation Council upper house of parliament, there on Monday. Earlier on Monday, the Kremlin press office had said Yeltsin was still in hospital.
The spokesman said the timeframe to get the president ready for the operation would not be changed.
Doctors said late last month it would take six to ten weeks to prepare the president for the operation, which will improve the blood supply to his heart.
